questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The de Broglie wavelength of an electron accelerated through a potential difference V is:
questions.explanation: KE = eV = p²/(2m) → p = √(2meV). λ = h/p = h/√(2meV).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In a full-wave rectifier, the output frequency is ____ of input frequency f:
questions.explanation: A full-wave rectifier inverts both halves of the AC cycle, doubling the frequency. Output = 2f.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The order of a reaction with rate = k[A]²[B] is:
questions.explanation: Overall order = sum of exponents = 2 + 1 = 3 (third order reaction).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following complexes is optically active?
questions.explanation: cis-[CoCl₂(en)₂]⁺ lacks a plane of symmetry and is non-superimposable on its mirror image (chiral), hence optically active. The trans form has a plane of symmetry.

questions.question: The structure of IF₇ is:
questions.explanation: IF₇: I has 7 bond pairs, 0 lone pairs. sp³d³ hybridization → pentagonal bipyramidal geometry.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The general solution of dy/dx = y/x is:
questions.explanation: dy/y = dx/x. ln|y| = ln|x| + ln C. y = Cx (family of straight lines through origin).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The eccentricity of a rectangular hyperbola is:
questions.explanation: For rectangular hyperbola: a = b. e = √(1 + b²/a²) = √(1+1) = √2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If A and B are independent events with P(A)=0.4 and P(B)=0.5, then P(A∩B) is:
questions.explanation: For independent events: P(A∩B) = P(A) × P(B) = 0.4 × 0.5 = 0.2.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The enzyme Telomerase is a:
questions.explanation: Telomerase is a reverse transcriptase — it uses its own RNA template to synthesize DNA at chromosome ends (telomeres).

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: C₄ plants differ from C₃ plants in having:
options: No photorespiration and no other difference
questions.explanation: C₄ plants use the Hatch-Slack pathway (C₄ cycle) in mesophyll cells before Calvin cycle in bundle sheath cells. This minimizes photorespiration.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which of the following is a correct statement about prions?
options: They are infectious proteins without nucleic acid
They are a type of virus
questions.explanation: Prions are misfolded proteins that can cause disease (e.g., mad cow disease). They lack any nucleic acid (DNA or RNA).

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The technique ELISA is used for:
questions.explanation: ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay) detects and quantifies antigens or antibodies using enzyme-linked reactions. Used in HIV testing, pregnancy tests, etc.
